import { r as useDashPanelHostId } from "./panel-controller-BCfpvTn5.mjs";
import { ComponentType, ReactNode } from "react";
import { PicodashFieldDefinitions, ScopedNexus } from "@picodash/nexus";
type DashPanelTransferPoint = {
  readonly pointerId: number;
  readonly clientX: number;
  readonly clientY: number;
};
interface DashPanelTransferDriver {
  place(left: number, top: number): void;
  begin(point: DashPanelTransferPoint): void;
  cancel(): void;
}
interface DashPanelTransfer {
  readonly layoutNexus: ScopedNexus<PicodashFieldDefinitions>;
  readonly returnLabel: string;
  readonly returnIcon?: ReactNode;
  readonly returnHome: () => void;
  readonly register: (driver: DashPanelTransferDriver) => () => void;
  /** True reserves the gesture for the host's return target instead of Panel docking. */
  readonly pointer: (phase: 'move' | 'drop' | 'cancel', point: DashPanelTransferPoint) => boolean;
}
export declare function DashPanelTransferBoundary({ transfer, children }: {
  readonly transfer: DashPanelTransfer;
  readonly children: ReactNode;
}): import("react").JSX.Element;
interface DashPanelContextHotkeyProps {
  binding: string | undefined;
  panelName: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  description?: string;
  onCommit: (binding: string | null) => string | undefined;
  onToggle: () => void;
}
/** Bounded integration seam: eligibility follows the nearest original Panel, not DOM relocation. */
export declare function DashPanelContextHotkey(props: DashPanelContextHotkeyProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null;
export interface DashPanelDefaultActionItemsProps {
  readonly scopeId: string;
}
export type DashPanelDefaultActionItems = ComponentType<DashPanelDefaultActionItemsProps>;
export interface DashPanelIntegrationProviderProps {
  readonly children: ReactNode;
  readonly defaultActionItems?: DashPanelDefaultActionItems;
}
export declare function DashPanelIntegrationProvider({ children, defaultActionItems }: DashPanelIntegrationProviderProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
export { type DashPanelContextHotkeyProps, type DashPanelTransfer, type DashPanelTransferDriver, type DashPanelTransferPoint, useDashPanelHostId };
